# agent-ready-poc

> Baseline placeholder for an AI advancement firm targeting skilled trades and local services. Real brand and content land at Checkpoint 4 of the project's build plan.

## Pages

- [Home](/index.html): iter-0 baseline placeholder page.

## About

This site is a proof-of-concept that an autonomous agent can ship a complete, modern, secure, accessible, agent-ready static site on Cloudflare end-to-end. The current state is intentionally minimal — measurements at this stage establish the baseline against which subsequent iterations are compared.
